facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported automatic-title-flow interpretation with exact guards, repeated queries and exceptional branch behavior.
facts.value: Each frame snapshots playback state and discards the playback-counter getter result. It records a local flag when xC is set and queried movie status is zero, then enters the exit block for a subsequent nonzero status, triggered Start/A, or that flag. After audio shutdown calls it requests exit through gm_801A4B74 for the flag case, otherwise gm_801A4B60. A fresh Start/A query takes routing priority, plays the forward sound and queues GM_TITLE. Otherwise, only when gmMainLib_8015DB00() != 5 does it increment the sequence value and request next state ID 0; value 5 still permits the exit request but suppresses those advancement calls. The meaning of xC and numeric value 5 is left unspecified.
